name: pxc04e
transitions: real->protected (CR0.PE 0->1, CS far-jump to 32-bit flat code segment 0x08)

page tables: PT0 identity for the low structures/stack/code window EXCEPT PT0[3]: linear 0x3000 -> phys 0x600000, starting NOT-PRESENT; PT1[0] present, PT1[1] not-present (the pfault demand-page target); CR3 load + CR0.PG 0->1

case A (atomicity): fnstenv at linear 0x2FFE (beat 0 spans 0x2FFE-0x3001) with page 3 NP -> #PF(CR2=0x3000) BEFORE any commit; the handler verifies the page-1 sentinel 0xA5A5A5A5 at 0x2FFC-0x2FFF is untouched (marker 0x2038=0x600DF00D), maps page 3 -> phys 0x600000, IRETs; the fnstenv restarts and completes

case B (correctness, non-contiguous frames): the 28-byte FENV image lands split across phys 0x2FFE / phys 0x600002+; deterministic fields after fninit+fnop: CW=0x037F (0x2FFE, the crossing beat's page-1 bytes), SW=0 (0x3002), TW=0xFFFF (0x3006); FIP/FCS/FOP recorded for the differential; word field reads only (reserved image bytes never observed)
pfault flow: demand-page #PF at 0x401000 (restart + readback 0xCAFEBABE), #GP on selector 0x38 past the GDT limit, #UD on UD2; counters accumulate to 4

witnesses.ecx at exit: 4 -- two #PF (crossing + demand-page) + one #GP + one #UD all delivered
witnesses.edx at exit: 0x004000F4 -- CR2 0x401000 captured by the demand-page #PF, low 16 bits clobbered by the 0xF4 exit-port load
witnesses.edi at exit: 0x600DF00D -- case A: the page-1 sentinel survived the rejected crossing store (pre-probe rejected BEFORE any write)
witnesses.ebx at exit: 0xFFFF037F -- (TW<<16)|CW read back through the split image (page 3 = phys 0x600006 / page 2 = phys 0x2FFE)

description: REVIEW1_Aug3 R2-C03 regression for producer S_FENV_ST: the generic page-crossing fragment engine must complete a crossing FNSTENV (28-byte 32-bit environment image, 4-byte beats, beat 0 straddling) with architecturally correct results. Differential against QEMU (cputlb.c mmu_lookup looks up BOTH pages before any byte commits). Case A: with page 3 not-present the crossing store #PFs with CR2=0x3000 and the page-1 bytes are provably untouched. Case B: with page 3 on the non-adjacent phys frame 0x600000 the restarted image's CW/SW/TW fields read back correctly through the split (poisoned wrong frame + seeded right frame make any wrong-physical-page access observable). Built on the pfault skeleton, whose #PF/#GP/#UD deliveries still run and count.
